rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_accident2(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	mm varchar(2)  NOT NULL,
  visit int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  death int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  AETYPE7 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	AETYPE8 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	TRAFFIC1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	TRAFFIC2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	TRAFFIC3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	TRAFFIC8 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	TRAFFIC9 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,mm),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_accident2 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_accident2
(

SELECT
  @id,a.hospcode
	,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,month(datetime_serv)  
	,COUNT(DISTINCT a.hospcode,a.pid,a.seq) target
	,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) result
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(aeplace in(7) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(aeplace in(8) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TRAFFIC in(1) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TRAFFIC in(2) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TRAFFIC in(3) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r5
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TRAFFIC in(8) OR TRAFFIC IS NULL ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r6
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TRAFFIC in(9) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r7

FROM 
	tmp_accident a LEFT JOIN tmp_service s ON a.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND a.PID=s.pid AND a.SEQ=s.seq
INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE h.provcode in (@prov_c) AND a.AETYPE in(1) AND a.AEPLACE in(7,8) 
AND DATE_FORMAT(datetime_serv,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY a.hospcode,month(datetime_serv)
);
rows.notice:
- ผู้ป่วยอุบัติเหตุทางถนน ประมวลผลจากแฟ้ม ACCIDENT โดยที่ AETYPE =01 และ AEPLACE เป็น 07,08
- เสียชีวิตเชื่อมโยงกับ SERVICE โดยที่ TYPEOUT เป็น 4,5,6
- สถานที่เกิดอุบัติเหตุจาก Field AEPLACE
- ประเภทผู้บาดเจ็บ(อุบัติเหตุจราจร) จาก Field TRAFFIC

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT concat(h.hcode) as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,sum(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,sum(aetype7) as aetype7 ,SUM(aetype8) as aetype8 ,sum(traffic1) as traffic1 ,SUM(traffic2) as traffic2 ,sum(traffic3) as traffic3 ,SUM(traffic8) as traffic8,SUM(traffic9) as traffic9  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ampurcodefull as ar_code,ampurname as ar_name,ampurcodefull as l_code FROM campur GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,4)=ar.l_code     INNER JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as hcode,chospital_regis.* FROM chospital_regis INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital_regis.provcode=cchangwat.changwatcode WHERE chospital_regis.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND chospital_regis.hdc_regist=1 AND chospital_regis.status ='1' AND (zonecode={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hoscode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hcode     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp sp ON sp.hcode=h.hoscode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))     AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (sp.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL') GROUP BY concat(h.hcode)
